versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'findstr'
        - '.vbs'
        - '.lnk'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\explorer.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") CommandLine="*findstr*" CommandLine="*.vbs*" CommandLine="*.lnk*"
